inputRootSignature: theorem poisson_sum_distribution {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (lambda : Fin n → ℝ) (hlambda : ∀ i, 0 < lambda i) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℕ) (hX_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P) (hX_pmf : ∀ i m, (P {ω | X i ω = m}).toReal = Real.exp (-(lambda i)) * (lambda i) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) (k : ℕ) : let S : Ω → ℕ := fun ω => ∑ i : Fin n, X i ω let Lambda : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin n, lambda i (P {ω | S ω = k}).toReal = Real.exp (-Lambda) * Lambda ^ k / (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)
